title: Business Head - South America
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: BUSINESS HEAD - South America (Remote)

Company: HD Software Systems (HDSOFT)

Location: Remote

Reporting to: CEO / Board of Directors

1. MISSION & SCOPE

The Business Head is responsible for defining and executing HDSOFT’s overall business strategy within their assigned territory. You will manage the full P&L, moving from an initial "Hunter" sales approach to building a sustainable, recurring revenue stream. You will champion our core FinTech portfolio, including HD-PAY, WhatsApp Banking, QR Solutions, Pulse Monitoring, and DataVision.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Strategic Leadership & Market Penetration

  • Strategy Execution: Define and execute the regional business strategy aligned with HDSOFT’s product portfolio (Payment Hub, Digital Banking, Data Visualization, and QR Solutions).
  • Expansion: Lead aggressive market penetration into high-growth markets (e.g., Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica ).
  • P&L Ownership: Own the regional Profit and Loss statement, overseeing pricing models, commercial structures, and contract negotiations to ensure long-term sustainability.

B. Revenue Generation & Sales Lifecycle

  • End-to-End Sales: Own the entire lifecycle from lead generation and C-level engagement to proposal, complex negotiation, and final closure.
  • Hunter to Farmer: Drive initial high-value enterprise sales and transition them into long-term recurring revenue via Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) .
  • GTM Strategy: Lead product positioning and go-to-market strategies, working closely with India-based engineering teams to align software solutions with local market needs.

C. Legacy Rescue & Technical Advocacy

  • Modernization Expert: Identify banks struggling with "unsupported" legacy systems. Position HDSOFT as the expert rescue team capable of supporting or migrating these systems via our API Development and Data Migration services.
  • Technical Bridge: Act as the primary stakeholder liaison between international clients and our global delivery center in India, ensuring technical requirements are translated with 100% precision.

D. Relationship & Risk Management

  • Ecosystem Building: Maintain high-level relationships with banks, financial regulators, and strategic local partners.
  • Market Intelligence: Track competitor movements, digital banking trends, and regulatory changes to mitigate risks and seize growth opportunities.

3. CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Experience: 9 –12+ years in Enterprise Software Sales, specifically within the Banking/FinTech sector; Retired/Ex Banking sector candidates are also preferred.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Transaction Management, Regulatory Reporting, and Digital Payments.
  • Network: An active "Rolodex" of decision-makers (CIOs/CTOs) in the target region.
  • Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills; ability to navigate cultural nuances between regional clients and Indian delivery teams.
  • Education: MBA or equivalent; Engineering background is a strong advantage.

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

The What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Paths to Work on the Project

  • Streaming & High-Throughput Data
    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
    • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.
  • GenAI & Autonomous Agents
    • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Graph & Knowledge Engineering
    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
    • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Responsibilities

  • Job Duties: We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

  • Technical Orchestration: Drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. Decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. Review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces connectivity issues between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You Do Not Need To Be An Expert In Every Single Tool, But You Must Be Able To Discuss Technical Trade-offs Across The Entire Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

TECNICO SEGURANCA DO TRABALHO

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

The domain of safety is managed and developed on the site:

  • The external and internal requirements of the domain are identified (regulatory watch and prescriptions). Based on gap analyses, action plans are proposed. The guarantee of the site's compliance with internal regulations and requirements is controlled.
  • The site has relevant and exhaustive risk analyses and action plans are defined.
  • In the context of design projects, the purchase of new machines, technical transformations of equipment or organizational changes in jobs, the position of the site safety specialist is defined and transmitted to the project team in the form of an “Avis EP”.
  • The current operating anomalies in the domain are analysed and taken into account. The necessary alerts are transmitted.
  • Good practices are shared within the site and across the country. The site safety specialist participates in or leads the business meetings of his network.
  • The annual review of the domain is presented by the site safety specialist during the EP Management Sytem Review of the site.
  • The safety specialist is the leader in his domain in terms of team support, management system and site events: steering committees, bib events, training.
  • External and internal partners are identified, and the safety specialist is the site's referent in these networks.
  • Technical support in the domain will be provided in the event of an audit (EP Management system or other audit/inspection) and in the event of a crisis impacting the area.
  • If necessary, specific projects in the field will be conducted in the form of transversal management (T-shape for example).
  • Where possible, participation in audits of other sites or even the conduct of audits will be entrusted to the site's safety specialist.
  • Where possible, the coordination of the domain at the country level will be carried out by the site safety specialist, under the guidance of the time zone.

title: Senior Director, Defect Management
description:
THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Director to Lead our Defect Management Team specializing in Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Management and resolution of defects, to join our cybersecurity team.

Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), you will play a crucial role in identifying, evaluating, and mitigating security risks associated with vulnerabilities and defects throughout the LNE organization. You will lead a team of multidisciplinary professionals and work closely with cross-functional teams across geographical regions to ensure that vulnerabilities are effectively prioritized, remediated, and monitored, thereby protecting the organization’s assets and sensitive data. As a part of this role, the candidate will be required to clearly and effectively communicate the business impact and urgency of security defects, while closely following the defined risk management process.

This position is also responsible for defining the expected outcomes of and reporting metrics for Defect Management across the Live Nation Entertainment enterprise, ensuring high quality configuration and defect remediation.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Develop, lead, and manage a high-performing security team of multiple skill sets across multiple locations
  • Enhance the Defect Management Framework, ensuring Compliance, Regulatory, and best practices is at its core
  • Cultivate the strategic direction, training, and evolution of the team to remain highly effective at various aspects of Cyber Security engagement
  • Proactively research and communicate emerging security threats through technical knowledge of the environments we operate in
  • Conduct hands-on technical security awareness training for software architects and development groups.
  • Foster effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
  • Empower the team, lead by example, and mentor all levels of competency
  • Champion improvements to internal programs and processes
  • Engage in threat modelling, security design reviews, infrastructure penetration testing, and security issue remediation verification
  • Work with application teams’ enterprise-wide to detect, prioritize, and remediate security defects throughout the SDLC process. The goal is to inject a security mindset throughout the full SDLC from concept to testing and implementation.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience working in a technical security position, penetration testing, information security hardening technologies and techniques or similar background
  • 5+ years of experience in Cyber Security related domains, with knowledge of security fundamentals, application vulnerabilities, attack vectors, penetration testing methodologies, and tools
  • 5+ years of experience driving Information Security initiatives across large diverse organizations
  • 5+ years of experience communicating with a wide range of technical & non-technical partners and senior leadership
  • Proficiency working with recognized IT Security-related standards and technologies
  • Training in Information Security-specific disciplines
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills
  • Knowledge of information security standards, rules, and regulations related to information security and data confidentiality, and desktop, server, application, database, and network security principles for risk identification and analysis
  • Experience with performing all elements of penetration testing and system exploitation against applications, APIs, Web, Mobile, and Modern Infrastructure (Containers, Microservices, Serverless etc.)
  • Experience with conducting penetration and malicious user testing in Cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and on-premises systems
  • Track record of building and growing talent with experience building and effectively managing large and diverse teams, and putting the appropriate processes and infrastructure in place to drive growth within a successful company
  • Ability to identify, attract, hire, develop, and retain the best security professionals needed to staff a world class organization and ensure they have the vision, plan, support, and culture in place to deliver impact.
  • Ethical character with ability to keep information confidential

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Amazon Kuiper is seeking an experienced, self-motivated Sales Professional to lead the adoption of Amazon Kuiper broadband and related services with maritime and offshore partners and end users in Brazil. This role is a unique opportunity to build and execute our sales pipeline with major offshore operators, service contractors, and merchant marine customers.


The ideal candidate has a strong track record in selling to, managing, and supporting large Energy sector clients, with maritime experience preferred. Knowledge of agriculture, OEM, and aviation industries is a plus. A solid understanding of satellite communications, experience working with global remote teams, and the ability to manage complex, long-term deals from start to finish are essential.


You will be responsible for growing maritime and mobility opportunities in Brazil, managing both direct and channel engagements.   • Contribute to build out of Amazon Kuiper service revenue with specific focus on Mobility partners and end users.

Howard University is a comprehensive, research-oriented, historically Black private university providing an educational experience of exceptional quality to students of high academic potential with particular emphasis upon the provision of educational opportunities to promising Black students. Further, the University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching and research, committed to the development of distinguished and compassionate graduates and to the quest for solutions to human and social problems in the United States and throughout the world.

Position Information

Salary Commensurate With Qualifications, Education & University Guidelines.

Basic Function: This position takes a lead role in planning and assessment activities coordinated by Institutional Research & Assessment (IRA), under the Office of the Provost. Specifically, this position coordinates all surveys (external and internal) within IRA and coordinates all technology platforms.

Supervisory Accountability: May be responsible for supervising and directing work of undergraduate and graduate students.

Nature And Scope: Internal contacts include Deans, Department Chairs, staff, faculty, and students. External contacts include affiliated schools, national research centers, and assessment/student learning organizations.

Principal Accountabilities

Facilitates engagement in and provides support and direction for the assessment of the general education curriculum.

Designs, administers, and analyzes institutional surveys.

Supports assessment and accreditation activities across the university through consulting, review, and technical support.

Co-manages assessment platform for the university (Watermark), offering technical support, troubleshooting, updating users, and creating support material for users.

Manages course evaluation platform (Course Evaluations & Surveys by Watermark) and coordinates with campus partners regarding its effectiveness and efficiency.

Leads the administration, research and reporting related to university survey initiatives such as student engagement (NSSE), faculty survey (FSSE), First-Year experience (CIRP), Course Evaluations and internal university survey projects administered via Qualtrics.

Serves as a central support unit for internal surveys across campus (Qualtrics training, survey consulting, survey creation and distribution for university leadership).

Performs other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Working knowledge of the literature on learner-centered assessment and evaluation, general education, rubrics as an assessment tool, high impact educational practices, surveys, response rates, and best practices in higher education assessment.

Experience executing a large-scale project successfully, from conceptualization through completion.

Ability to take direction, assume increasingly independent responsibility, and provide appropriate follow up on project-based work.

Ability to guide assistant director(s) and coordinator(s) to set deadlines, manage project completion, and develop staff.

Possess strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and reporting-writing skills.

Ability to create visual analytics and performance dashboards.

Ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Experience with designing, administering, and reporting on data from surveys. Knowledge of social science research methods.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

What You'll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI.

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io).

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: Write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: Understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • Take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade. O que você entrega faz diferença. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria. A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório. Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua. Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto. Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor. Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega. Nossa área de Infraestrutura e Financiamento de Projetos é formada por profissionais versáteis e com uma expertise diferenciada. title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management

Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services

Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)

Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary

Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;

Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil

Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.

Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team

Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

O que você fará:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Procuramos manter a transparência: nenhuma atividade é restritiva; a lista pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se apliquem ao cargo.

O que você precisar ter:

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

OInspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Analista TI Sr - Relacionamento com Clientes
description:
Atividades

Mapear, qualificar e priorizar demandas de TI, contribuindo na construção do backlog e assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e metas das áreas de negócio.

Compreender processos e requisitos de ponta a ponta, participando ativamente do mapeamento de fluxos,compreendendoindicadoresoperacionais, análise de valor e oportunidades de melhoria.

Facilitar a comunicação entre TI e negócio, atuando como ponte entre as áreas, participando de fóruns estratégicos, comitês e reuniões executivas, adaptando a linguagem ao público.

Apoiar a governança do ciclo de demandas, assegurando o uso de formulários padrão (ex:ServiceNow), critérios de priorização, SLAsdefinidos e visibilidade do portfólio de iniciativas.

Antecipar necessidades das áreas, atuando de forma consultiva antes da formalização das demandas, contribuindo em análises de viabilidade, escopo e alternativas tecnológicas.

Colaborar na qualificação funcional das iniciativas, atuando junto a Arquitetura, Projetos e áreas especializadas para garantir clareza de requisitos e viabilidade de solução.

Gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders, fortalecendo a confiança, o engajamento e a percepção de TI como parceira estratégica na transformação digital.

Conduzir ou apoiar treinamentos para usuários finais, organizando conteúdos, facilitando sessões (presenciais ou remotas) e promovendo a adoção das soluções entregues.

Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão da demanda, sugerindo ajustes em fluxos, ritos e comunicação executiva com base em indicadores e feedbacks recorrentes.

Orquestrar o programa deChampions(Key-Users), mobilizando e engajando a rede de usuários-chave nas áreas para atuarem como agentes de transformação e inovação.

Assegurar o alinhamento dosChampionscom a estratégia de TI, promovendo a priorização de demandasrelevantes, a melhoria de processos e a cultura Lean nas áreas.

Conduzir a rotina do programa deChampions, realizando reuniões periódicas, apoiando treinamentos bimestrais em tecnologias/metodologias e monitorando os impactos gerados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em técnicas de levantamento e análise de requisitos, com uso de entrevistas, workshops e documentação funcional.

Conhecimento sobre o ciclo de vida da demanda de TI, incluindo identificação, priorização, construção de backlog e critérios de avaliação de iniciativas.

Conhecimento de DesignThinking , aplicando técnicas de ideação, brainstorming e mapa mental para construção de soluções centradas no usuário.

Conhecimento básico em plataformas de ITSM como o ServiceNow , para registro, acompanhamento e documentação de demandas de TI.

Domínio do pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) e ferramentas colaborativas como Microsoft Teams,Planner, entre outras.

  • Familiaridade com BusinessChangeCanvas , compreendendo o impacto de mudanças em pessoas, processos e tecnologias.

Formação Acadêmica

Superior completo em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação e áreas afins.

title: Médico do Trabalho
description:
Quer fazer parte de um time que impulsa o progresso por meio da energia? Na Light, buscamos um Médico do Trabalho que será responsável em contribuir para promoção da saúde e segurança da força de trabalho, a partir da prevenção, do controle e da eliminação de riscos no ambiente de trabalho com o objetivo de prevenir perdas relacionadas ás pessoas e ao patrimônio material da empresa. Traga a sua energia para a Light!

Responsabilidades

Seus principais desafios serão:

  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais e clínicos conforme os riscos dos postos de trabalho.
  • Atender emergências médicas e realizar encaminhamentos adequados.
  • Integrar-se à equipe de enfermagem do trabalho, promovendo saúde e segurança.
  • Avaliar acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, emitindo pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar colaboradores acidentados, inclusive em ambiente hospitalar.
  • Analisar postos de trabalho para identificar e minimizar riscos à saúde.
  • Elaborar laudos e relatórios sobre acidentes, doenças e insalubridade.
  • Prestar primeiros socorros e organizar remoções em casos graves.
  • Promover ações de saúde com base em dados epidemiológicos.
  • Participar de auditorias médicas e do gerenciamento de saúde ocupacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho com registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina - RQE.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação de Medicina do Trabalho, com ênfase nas Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) do Ministério do Trabalho, nas diretrizes dos Conselhos Federal e Regional de Medicina, da ANAMT e do Ministério da Saúde.
  • Domínio de técnicas de gestão de saúde ocupacional, alinhadas às premissas do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) da empresa, com foco na prevenção de riscos e promoção da saúde dos colaboradores.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas e softwares de gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, para registro, análise e acompanhamento de dados ocupacionais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de Seg a Sex de 13 ás 17 - 20h semanais

Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxilio farmácia;
  • Wellhub;
  • Convênios com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Informações extras:

Local de Trabalho: Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Missão

O Head de Tecnologia da Proativa Capital é responsável por estruturar e implementar o modelo de segurança nos sistemas, plataformas e acessos da empresa.

Além disso, deverá gerenciar a inovação e os novos projetos, coordenando as equipes de tecnologia, infraestrutura e segurança, garantindo que as soluções tecnológicas contribuam para o crescimento, inovação e eficiência dos processos da empresa.

  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com a diretoria e equipes técnicas;
  • Vivência com soluções inovadoras e projetos de transformação digital.

Competências Técnicas e Comportamentais

Técnicas

  • Expertise em ferramentas de gestão de TI e segurança de sistemas.
  • Profundo conhecimento de ERPs, infraestrutura de TI, redes e sistemas operacionais.
  • Habilidade em implementar soluções de segurança, incluindo criptografia, backup e controles de acesso.

Comportamentais

Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients?

Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About The Job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration. You will represent the company in day-to-day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills. At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA,MC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market. Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What Your Day-to-day Would Look Like

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data-driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail-oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value-selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short-term disability insurances with SulAmerica
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels.

As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

A área de IAM é responsável por garantir que cada pessoa e sistema tenha o acesso certo, no momento certo e apenas ao que precisa, usando ferramentas como Entra ID, Active Directory e SailPoint. Ela cuida de todo o ciclo de vida do usuário, desde a criação da conta, mudanças de função, até o desligamento, além de controlar acessos, autenticações e integrações com sistemas internos e SaaS.

  • Garantir que usuários, sistemas e aplicações tenham os acessos corretos e seguros;

  • Acompanhar e corrigir falhas de provisionamento e desprovisionamento;
  • Apoiar criação, alteração e remoção de acessos no MS Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint e aplicações integradas;
  • Executar e acompanhar os fluxos de Joiner, Mover e Leaver;
  • Apoiar revisões de acesso e campanhas de certificação;
  • Testar e validar integrações via SCIM e APIs usando Postman;
  • Rodar e ajustar automações simples em PowerShell;
  • Documentar/atualizar processos;
  • Apoiar na governança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD);
  • Experiência com Active Directory (on-premises e híbrido);
  • Experiência com SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC);
  • Conhecimento em Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver);
  • Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de contas e acessos;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC (controle de acesso baseado em papéis);
  • Noções de auditoria de acessos, revisões e compliance (SoD, Least Privilege);
  • Experiência com Postman para testes e validação de integrações.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em SCIM;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, JSON e Web Services;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 e OpenID Connect);
  • Experiência com ferramentas ITSM, como Freshservice;
  • Conhecimento em PowerShell e/ou Python;
  • Experiência com Logic Apps e Azure Functions;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Key Vault (AKV) para gestão de segredos, credenciais e tokens;
  • Conhecimento em workflows, rules e transforms no SailPoint ISC;
  • Experiência com integração de aplicações corporativas e SaaS;
  • Noções de segurança em APIs;
  • Certificações em IAM, Cloud ou Segurança da Informação.

Local

Rio de Janeiro-RJ ou São Paulo-SP

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. description:
Job Title: E-Commerce Marketing Manager (DTC)

Location: Remote (UK Timezone)

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (GMT) with at least 4 hours overlap.

NOTE: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION

Are you an experienced Digital Marketing Manager with a passion for driving growth in the DTC e-commerce space? Are you looking for a fully remote role that allows you to work independently while driving high-impact strategies for a fast-growing global brand?

If so, this opportunity could be perfect for you...

About The Role:

We are a fast moving, Shopify DTC e-commerce brand in the health and wellness space looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to lead customer acquisition and growth initiatives across multiple channels.

As an independent contractor, you’ll have the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world, while spearheading impactful campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and email marketing with Klaviyo.

You’ll also oversee a marketing team and manage projects that amplify new customer acquisition, retention, and overall performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer acquisition & growth: Build and execute strategies to drive new customer acquisition via Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and email marketing (Klaviyo), focusing on lowering CAC and improving LTV.
  • Full funnel management: Design and optimise the complete marketing funnel—from awareness to retention—ensuring every part of the customer journey is crafted to deliver exceptional growth and performance.
  • Team leadership & collaboration: Manage, mentor, and work alongside a remote team of digital marketers while also collaborating with external stakeholders. Ensure marketing projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard.
  • Project management: Lead marketing initiatives from planning to execution, ensuring cross-functional alignment between product, creative, and content teams. Keep campaigns tightly managed with clear objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Data-driven insights: Develop, monitor, and analyse KPIs such as ROAS, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and CLTV, using data insights from tools such as GA4 and Triple Whale to steer campaign performance and make focused improvements. Forecast and report financial results weekly/monthly to identify growth opportunities.
  • Stay at the cutting edge: Keep up-to-date with evolving trends, platform updates, and competitors to deliver fresh, innovative solutions that stand out in a competitive market.

What You'll Bring:

  • Proven DTC e-commerce experience: Extensive knowledge and experience working with DTC brands is a must
  • Customer acquisition specialist: A deep understanding of multi-channel customer acquisition strategies, including paid search, paid social, and email marketing.
  • Remote team & project management: Previous experience in managing remote teams and leading digital marketing projects independently from start to finish, with a focus on collaboration and clear communication.
  • Results-oriented & data-savvy: Strong grasp of data analysis and performance metrics, with a knack for improving KPIs such as ROAS, CAC, and LTV.
  • Platform expertise: Hands-on experience using Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and Klaviyo for email marketing is essential.
  • Independent & proactive: You’ll need the ability to self-manage, set priorities, and adapt quickly to brand targets and performance goals while maintaining daily accountability.
  • Experience of using project management software such as Monday, Trello or Clickup.

What's On Offer:

  • Fully remote: Work independently from anywhere in the world. This role gives you the ultimate flexibility to operate from whichever time zone you call home.
  • Ownership of strategy: Lead the marketing strategy for a growing global e-commerce brand and drive powerful customer acquisition and retention campaigns.
  • Dynamic, remote team: Join a supportive and motivated global team that thrives on collaboration and innovation in the digital space.
  • Paid time off and flexible working.

If you're ready to lead from the front and scale a high-growth DTC brand in a fully remote role, we'd love to hear from you!
